GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Summarises a case for the next agent who opens it. Three versions: the active terse one, a fluent rewrite, and the fluent rewrite grounded with a retriever and an Apex provider.

templateVersions.description: The active version: terse instructions over the record and its comments.
The fluent rewrite: the same merge fields, instructions tuned for readability.
The fluent rewrite grounded with the Case_Knowledge_Retriever and the CaseSummaryGrounding Apex provider.
